subject: Commercial path & procurement readiness — next steps
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lane <emma.lane@novaterra.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial path & procurement readiness — next steps

Emma — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery and a set of concrete next steps so we can align on procurement path and signatory owners. TL;DR: Novaterra is leaning toward a 12‑month commit on Redwood Dedicated, likely via PO; finance needs a short checklist and we should confirm the final signatory and budget owner.

Key points from call:
- Primary use: inference for patient-notes summarization (privacy-sensitive).
- Preferred deployment: Dedicated (data isolation + SLA).
- Procurement preference expressed: Purchase Order (PO) but team will evaluate card payment for initial POC.
- Marketplace: Novaterra is open to AWS Marketplace if pricing and contract terms align (they want single‑invoice option).

Open questions we agreed to answer:
1) Who is the economic buyer / budget owner (name + email)?
2) Who is the finance sponsor that will approve PO and payment ops?
3) Who is the legal/contact for contract redlines and estimated review timeline?
4) Does Novaterra require SOC2 attestation + additional evidence (we can provide SOC2 and audit logs)?

Immediate next steps (owner in parentheses):
- Share short procurement readiness checklist and MAP (Dylan, attached).
- Confirm budget owner and finance approver (Emma / Samir).
- If marketplace is acceptable, route pricing sheet and marketplace contract notes (Marissa).
- If PO path chosen, Redwood to provide invoice specimen and PO instructions (Ben).

Attachments: Redwood-Provisioning-Checklist.xlsx (procurement checklist), Mutual-Action-Plan-Novaterra.pdf (MAP)

If you can confirm the three named roles and whether you prefer PO vs card for the pilot, we’ll lock the next steps and target timelines.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0147 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Redwood Inference — inference that scales

From: Emma Lane <emma.lane@novaterra.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@novaterra.com>, Procurement Ops <procure@novaterra.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial path & procurement readiness — next steps

Thanks for the clear recap, Dylan — appreciate the checklist. Quick answers from my side: 

- Economic buyer / budget owner: Samir Rao (Head of Data Platform) — samir.rao@novaterra.com. He owns the platform budget for pilot.
- Finance sponsor: procurement@novaterra.com (Procurement Ops) will route the PO; for approvals it goes to Finance Lead: Clara Nguyen (clara.nguyen@novaterra.com).
- Signatory: Legal will need to sign; primary contact is Meera Joshi (meera.joshi@novaterra.com), GC is final sig if > $150k.
- Security: Yes, SOC2 is required; we will need SOC2 report + pen test summary and an indication of encryption controls.

PO vs card: For the POC under $25k we can pay by card to speed things up. For the production (12 months) we will prefer PO (standard internal process).

Marketplace: We are open to AWS Marketplace but need to confirm that marketplaces support term commitments and single invoicing for our accounting system. If Redwood can provide an invoice flow that ties to a single PO it is fine.

Timeline: Samir wants procurement readiness confirmed by Nov 27 to include in December planning. Legal says contract review will take ~7–10 business days once they have a clean SOW.

I’ve copied Procurement Ops and Samir — they can confirm the PO process details and provide any templates.

—Emma
Emma Lane
Director, Infrastructure Platforms | Novaterra Health
emma.lane@novaterra.com | +1 206-555-0192

Emma / Samir / Procurement team — thanks for the quick responses and the role assignments. I’ve pulled together the brief signatory / approver matrix and next-step checklist below so everyone has one single snapshot. Please confirm or flag edits by EOD Monday (Nov 23) so Marissa and Ben can prepare pricing and invoicing artifacts.

Procurement snapshot (please confirm):
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Samir Rao — Head of Data Platform — samir.rao@novaterra.com (CONFIRMED)
- Finance sponsor / approver: Clara Nguyen — Finance Lead — clara.nguyen@novaterra.com (Procurement Ops will route POs to Clara)
- Procurement operations / PO processing: procure@novaterra.com (needs Redwood invoice spec and sample PO mapping)
- Legal / signatory: Meera Joshi — General Counsel — meera.joshi@novaterra.com (GC signs if contract > $150k)

Payment path options: 
- Pilot (< $25k): Card payment preferred (fast) — Redwood to send card invoice link. (Novaterra indicated ok.)
- Production (12 mo): PO preferred — standard vendor onboarding plus single invoice per quarter; Redwood to provide invoice specimen and vendor setup guide.
- Marketplace fallback: If AWS Marketplace supports single‑invoice per PO, Novaterra is willing to transact via marketplace. Marissa to confirm marketplace contract implications.

Required security artifacts:
- SOC2 Type II report (we will supply)
- Pen test summary (can provide redacted report)
- Encryption + data residency statement (we will provide short one‑page doc)

Attached: Redwood-Provisioning-Checklist.xlsx (procurement checklist), Mutual-Action-Plan-Novaterra.pdf (MAP with milestones). I’ve also added a small table below with the owner-driven next steps and dates.

Owner-run checklist and dates:
- Redwood: Send invoice specimen + vendor onboarding steps (Ben) — target: Nov 23
- Novaterra: Confirm PO template and internal PO routing (Procurement Ops) — target: Nov 24
- Redwood: Provide SOC2 package + encryption statement (Marissa) — target: Nov 24
- Legal: First pass SOW review (Meera / Novaterra Legal) — target: Dec 8 (7–10 business days)
- All: Final decision on PO vs marketplace by Nov 27 (Samir / Emma)

If that looks right I’ll escalate to our pricing team for the formal quote and marketplace notes. Ben — can you attach the invoice specimen and a short note on card payment capability? Marissa — can you confirm if marketplace affects the SLA terms or reporting?

Thanks — will follow up first thing Monday if I haven’t heard confirmations.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
